name: How much does it typically cost to build a bathroom in an ADU?

mainEntity.name: How much does it typically cost to build a bathroom in an ADU?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of building an ADU bathroom can vary significantly based on factors such as fixture selection, material quality, labor rates, and the complexity of plumbing extensions. For a standard ADU bathroom, costs might range from $15,000 to $30,000 or more. High-end finishes, custom cabinetry, or challenging site conditions requiring extensive utility trenching can increase this. It's important to budget for permits, inspections, and unforeseen issues. A detailed proposal from a contractor will provide a more accurate estimate for your specific project.
acceptedAnswer.description: ADU bathroom construction costs typically range from $15,000 to $30,000+, depending on fixture choices, material quality, and plumbing complexity.
